start.speaker: Kaito
start.text: Neon Dragon's closed to cops. But you don't look like a cop. You look like a man who's already drowning.

choices.text: Tell me about the dead man.

victim.speaker: Kaito
victim.text: He drank here that last night. Paid his whole tab — cash. Nobody does that unless they're settling up before they disappear.

discover.title: The Paid Tab
discover.desc: The victim paid off his entire bar tab in cash the night he died, as if expecting the end.

kanzaki.speaker: Kaito
kanzaki.text: ...You didn't get that name here. Kanzaki paid the tab FOR him. A dead man's debts, cleared by the syndicate. Ask yourself why.

discover.title: Kanzaki's Hand
discover.desc: The Kanzaki syndicate secretly paid the victim's tab. They were involved before he died.

bye.speaker: Kaito
bye.text: Then get out. The rain's warmer than the welcome here.
